digest.component_or_area: Test Suite (mirror) workflow / packaging and release tests
propositions: Release and packaging tests locate the repo root via Path(rebar.__file__).parents[2], which under non-editable installs resolves to site-packages/lib/ instead of the checkout, causing FileNotFoundError for repo-root-only artifacts (scripts/, hatch_build.py).

The sweep (macos, full suite) and sweep (declared lower-bound resolution) legs use non-editable installs (uv pip install with no --editable flag), while the merge-gate critical path uses editable installs (uv sync), creating an install-portability gap that masks regressions.

The declared hatchling floor (>=1.18) predates PEP 639 license-files table syntax in pyproject.toml, causing TypeError at --resolution lowest-direct; only hatchling >=1.27 accepts the current license-files declaration.

Fixing the editable-layout coupling (tests/_repo_root.py marker walk + AST guard) and raising hatchling floor to >=1.27 resolves the two documented root causes, verified as 0 FileNotFoundError and 0 license-files TypeError in mirror run 33299427686.

The two root causes remain latent pre-existing defects that could recur if tests are reverted to package-relative __file__ reaches or if hatchling floor is lowered without re-validating PEP 639 compatibility.
